menus.name: Omakase dinner menu

menus.name: Omakase lunch menu
menus.note: At the shared table; €210 at the tea ceremony counter, €220 at the chef's counter; no lunch on Wednesday

bookingOpens: Online through Zenchef, choosing the seat first, as the price depends on it: six seats at the chef's counter, four at the tea ceremony counter and six at the shared table. Bookings are required.
cancellation: A card is held to guarantee the booking and charged only for a no-show or a cancellation less than 48 hours ahead. A table may be given away after 30 minutes' delay.
groups: Up to ten people can book online; the shared table suits groups of more than two.
